learning_extracted: check_degeneracy's zero-spread test (metric_is_degenerate, _metrics.py:357-372) fires on spread<=eps BEFORE any floor/ceiling rail is consulted -- so a ceiling-saturated precondition (every seed pinned at a metric's maximum, by design or by near-vacuity) reads identically to a genuinely dead/broken metric in the reason string ('zero spread'), and only the manifest's own degenerate_metrics dict plus the driver's docstring can tell a reader which case they are looking at. This run's harm_class_fraction_on flag is exactly this ambiguity: consistent with EITHER 'the hazard-dense env worked as designed' OR 'the metric cannot distinguish any run with the harm stream on', and this autopsy could not resolve which from the recorded data alone (see environment row and fanout_recommendation)

A run-level scoring_excluded:degenerate tag on the indexer is coarser than the underlying defect: only ONE of the two load-bearing metrics check_degeneracy evaluated (harm_class_fraction_on) is degenerate; the paired ON-vs-OFF sat_factor contrast passes the SAME check, but passes it BY CONSTRUCTION (the OFF value is a hard-coded early return, dacc.py:237-238, and the ON value is the arithmetic constant this note derives) -- metric_groups_are_degenerate only asks whether the two arm members differ, so it could never have flagged this pairing regardless of whether either arm's value was itself measured or structural. A failure_autopsy recovering a run's qualitative interpretability from a coarse scoring_excluded tag must therefore separately check whether each surviving criterion carries genuine empirical content (per-criterion, not per-pass/fail) -- see the four_layer_diagnosis's per-criterion breakdown

The recurring 0.25 ON-arm sat_factor (bit-identical across all 3 seeds x 2 runs x independent machines) is exactly explained by the saturation arithmetic once the chronic-harm precondition saturates: n_rec capped at SAT_WINDOW=8, excess=SAT_WINDOW-SAT_GRACE=6, f_sat=1/(1+SAT_STRENGTH*excess)=1/(1+0.5*6)=0.25 (ree-v3/ree_core/cingulate/dacc.py:245-252), independently corroborated by V3-EXQ-463's UC4_monotone_in_recurrences ladder at the same excess value. A reader who does not know this arithmetic could easily (and wrongly) read a bit-identical cross-seed, cross-machine result as evidence of a hardcoded/fabricated readout rather than a predictable consequence of a saturating precondition -- worth citing explicitly in any future reference to this run
